_doc: diagrams: {"<n>": ["<placement>", ...]} replaces a recognised diagram (one placement per position).

positions: hypothetical positions the text describes but does not print. Each entry is matched in the paragraph that starts on `page` (or the page before) containing `match`; move sequences after that point start from this position first.
base: diagram number ("295B" / "622R" for one half of a double diagram); default: the diagram being discussed.
fen: a full placement instead of base; shift: [files, ranks]; edit: list of edits (see positions.py): "K@c6" move the unique piece, "+Rd6" add, "-e4" clear, "K<>B" swap.
stm: side to move if the text fixes it (otherwise the first line decides); note: shown in the app.
